reasons: The deletion of §12.4 implements the playbook's preferred position (no non-solicit binding Customer) for a clause that sits at the walk-away line: one-way, covering all Vendor employees, 24 months, and a true no-hire ('regardless of how the employee applies') with no general-advertising or unsolicited-applicant carve-out.

Full deletion is justified rather than narrowing because the clause is one-sided and includes a no-hire, and the negotiated fallback (mutual, involved personnel only, 12 months, with carve-outs) is offered in the comment as required.
The comment is accurate on the facts, correctly cites the internal contradiction with §12.3 (Vendor acknowledges no no-hire commitment), and matches the required tone and prefix.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤12 months; carve-out present) are artefacts of the paragraph being deleted entirely, not evidence of an incomplete edit; the high change ratio is inherent to a rule-sanctioned deletion.
